title: PHS 398 Training Subaward Budget Attachment(s) Form
description: Attach a completed PHS 398 Training Budget for each consortium member. Each of the 30 numbered slots accepts one original fillable PDF.

children.label: Training subaward budgets
children.help_text: Get the blank PHS 398 Training Budget from the opportunity’s package in Grants.gov Workspace. Complete one copy per consortium member, following the agency instructions. Attach the original fillable PDF to the appropriate slot. Printing or converting the file to PDF can remove the budget data.

notes: No slot is required on an empty form. The funding opportunity determines which consortium budgets the applicant must supply.

The DAT describes each numbered slot as an attached file. The XSD defines ATT1 through ATT30 as text. In a single-budget Grants.gov Training submission, ATT1 held the budget name, BudgetAttachments contained the budget, and the agency received the included justification as a separate file. The upload ID has no XML element.
The Grants.gov Workspace package provides the fillable budget. Form installation must give applicants access to that template. The read-only form catalog PDF does not contain it.
Imported costs and rates use unsigned decimal text with up to two decimal places. This keeps 0.00 in XML. An importer must normalize equivalent XML values such as +1.00 and .50 to this notation.
risks: Form installation must read the completed budget and its embedded justification before accepting a replacement. If a PDF is unreadable or has been flattened, identify the affected slot and keep its previously saved budget.
